limits: Published dataset and successful CI steps, not raw per-endpoint HTTP transcripts
No tools/call; no application workflow, installation, payment, signature verification or memory operation established
Own prose calls it two requests, code also sends initialized notification
Prior client name in unrelated AEfact stats not counted as a new operator mention
Course appears in Sources; main text does not evaluate it
Human editorial review, course completion, lab execution or institutional adoption not established
Separate domains do not establish distinct beneficial owners

package_graphs.limits: Specific package versions and one index; no statement about private apps, manual installs or HTTP clients

pull_requests.interpretation: Three known contributor docs PRs; fourth changes the ecosystem's Pages site, not an outside runtime deployment

unrecovered_query_strings: "AttestedMemory" (site:t.me OR site:vk.com OR site:weibo.com OR site:note.com)
web_search.limits: Batch membership does not certify individual query execution. Literal structured-field deduplication only. Three unaffected queries recovered separately; Weibo not retried.

mutations: Local audit artifacts only. No purchases, paid APIs, invokes, messages, installs, foreign code execution, deployments, authentication changes or GitHub/Gitea writes by us.
